title: Grilled Baba Ghanoush Eggplant
description: A Middle Eastern-inspired eggplant dish, perfect for a light dinner or snack. Roasting the eggplant brings out its natural sweetness, which pairs well with the smoky flavors of grilled vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and brush with olive oil.
Season the eggplant with salt and black pepper.
Grill the eggplant for 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and tender.
Scoop the eggplant flesh into a bowl and mash with a fork.
Add the baba ghanoush, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the eggplant mixture to a serving dish and garnish with parsley and mint, if desired.
